This must be a battle-map token viewed from almost directly above, not an elevated front portrait.
Keep the exact lean man with very short dark hair, dark tailored overcoat, grey shirt, burgundy tie, concealed vest under clothing, dark trousers, brown boots, plain belt knife sheath and ONE lowered black SEMI-AUTOMATIC pistol in the right hand. Left hand empty. Preserve his face identity where visible; no revolver, bald head, extra equipment or external tactical armour. Preserve colours and restrained painterly shading.
Keep all hands, feet and weapon/fabric tips safely inside the square. No ground, scene, base, ring, long shadow, letters, checkerboard or coloured backdrop.
